svg.title: Agent Squad: one batch through the pipeline
svg.desc: Forge plans, Chisel opens two issues, you lift the review gate, Ralph loops Cody over each issue (tests first, the second PR stacked on the first), you review with Reven and fix one note in a sidecar, retarget the child PR to main and merge both, and lore-checkpoint updates status.

g.text: Forge plans the change and sizes it
Chisel turns the plan into issues #12 and #13, both labelled needs-review
Ralph's loop, issue 1 of 2: #12 goes to Cody
Cody writes failing tests for #12, then code until green, then opens PR #12
Ralph loops, issue 2 of 2: #13 branches from #12's branch
Tests first again. PR #13 is stacked on #12's branch
You run Reven on each PR. Each diffs against its own base
You fix a review note on #13 in a sidecar worktree. “Done” pushes it
You retarget #13 to main, then merge #12

svg.text: Both PRs under review: #13 is stacked on #12’s branch until you retarget it to main
